en.summary: Canvases from cloud agents Cloud agents can now build interactive canvases as part of their work. Share a finished canvas with your team by sending its link.
en.details: Canvases from cloud agents Cloud agents can now build interactive canvases as part of their work. Share a finished canvas with your team by sending its link. Learn more about sharing canvases . Environments API The Environments API is now available in beta. Use it to programmatically create and manage the cloud environments your agents run in. Larger, faster environments Cloud agent environments now support up to 300 repositories. Large environments also load 5x faster.
